metadata.description: Skills that teach Claude to write, review and debug React the way senior React engineers do, plus a tool that measures and cuts re-renders in your app and proves the speed-up.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: React best-practice skills: re-renders and composition, memoization, reconciliation and keys, component API design, context, effects and cleanup, refs and closures, layout and portals, data fetching, error handling, interaction responsiveness (INP), large lists and virtualization, loading performance (bundles, code splitting, images, fonts, Core Web Vitals), and animation.

plugins.name: react-render-audit
plugins.description: Measure and cut React re-renders in a real React or Next.js app without changing behavior, then prove the speed-up: /optimize-renders counts every component render and why, fixes the worst causes with the react-best-practices skills, proves behavior stayed identical, and times old and new code side by side on mobile and desktop profiles with confidence intervals.
